description:
Commercial chassis of Japanese pickup truck.
That one is strange workhorse extravaganza of oversized commercial pickup.  
The model was created on the basis of a previously made mid-80s pickup truck, and underwent a facelift for the 90s update. Added plastic elements and skirts to protect the bodywork from harsh use. The quality is not the highest, since I did not initially intend to make a bare chassis.

I unconditionally give you permission to use this model at your discretion, modify it or implement it into a digital product. Use the model as you see fit and have a nice day.
